digest.component_or_area: store write lock acquisition and retry
propositions: A store write whose lock acquisition times out is permanently discarded with no retry, even when the holder duration alone (70-163s) exhausts the fixed 60s budget
The acquire() function computes one deadline shared by both fcntl and mkdir lock legs, so `attempts` acts as a silent multiplier rather than a retry loop, creating terminal loss under contention
Bounded retry-with-backoff inside acquire() converts lock-timeout loss into latency without replaying the write body, since LockTimeout is raised before the caller's transaction executes
Five call sites opt in to retries via write_path_retries() reading REBAR_LOCK_RETRIES (default 2, clamped [0,10]), with a ~181.5s ceiling (3 passes × 60s + ~1.5s backoff) and per-pass warning logging
The retry default of retries=0 preserves fail-fast for unedited callers (compaction, fsck, doctor, reconciler, sweeps) without any code change to those sites

Plan-review gate certification failed twice due to this bug destroying the PASS attestation write under 88-163s holders, proving holder duration routinely exhausts the budget on normal developer hosts
